findings: RU and EN fact previews preserve multiline editorial text, source identifiers and citation metadata without overlap at320px.
Existing editor, plain preview and interactive answer previews remain readable in narrow and desktop viewports.
Optional fact inputs and the source-review notice remain visually distinct from ordinary route and activity controls.
limitations: Viewport slices do not show every control simultaneously; long fact citations continue below the captured viewport and reachability is covered by browser interaction.
These are actual admin editor component captures, not screenshots of the mobile app or authenticated staff shell.
Desktop import failure is the intentional read-error fixture; edits remain preserved.
Synthetic citation metadata has not been fetched or factually verified; human review is still required.
